spanish: Y verá el sacerdote la carne la viva, y lo impurecerá; la carne la viva impura ella; lepra ella.

findings.issue: The 3ms object suffix is «lo», which does not resume feminine «la carne» and can be read as another masculine participant.
Masculine adjective and 3ms pronouns are feminine in Spanish to agree with carne and lepra; the second הוא is 3ms beside a feminine noun, and «ella» closes that mismatch.
findings.spanishSpan: la viva impura ella; lepra ella

notes: Seeing, the priest, the living flesh, piel 3ms, the verbless clauses, and lepra are licensed; no copula was added.
